description: C4 + Ogg Opus (.opus). The Ogg container cost was already paid in C4; this stage isolates the Opus decoder marginal cost. This profile is the full Common Formats capability set.

decoder:opus.reason: issue #8 capability intent: Ogg -> Opus decoder; preskip/end-trim correctness is part of the corpus gate

lib:swresample.reason: FFmpeg n9.0.1 configure hard dependency: the native Opus decoder selects swresample ('Disabled opus_decoder ... not all dependencies are satisfied: swresample'). SongCore does NOT use swr for its PCM contract; the library enters the closure only through the Opus decoder's own upstream build graph, and its actual member pull is measured by the link audit. Resampling remains out of scope.
